newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Edegel sets cash dividend from 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Edegel sets cash dividend from 1996 profit.

text.p: Peruvian electricity generator Edegel has agreed a cash dividend of 0.017 sol per share with an October 31 record date and a November 25 payout date, according to a Lima Stock Exchange report published Monday.
The total payout of the dividend, which is based on profits so far this year, will be 37.836 million soles distributed among 2.226 billion common shares, the report said.

In October 1995, the government sold a 60 percent stake in Edegel to the foreign-led Generandes consortium for $524.45 million. Generandes includes U.S.-based Entergy Corp's EP Edegel Inc unit, Chile's Empresa Nacional de Electricidad (Endesa), and local firms Grana y Montero and Banco Wiese Ltdo.
Edegel, which generates power for the Lima area, is comprised of five hydroelectric centrals and a thermal plant with a capacity to produce 700 megawatts (MW).
